result.description:
A CHANCE TO WORK WITH THE BEST, TO BE THE BEST
BAPL is an Australian-owned and operated independent, specialist, business analysis consultancy. We help our customers to be successful with project initiatives by delivering exceptional business analysis, as a service. We love technology and we are great at making it work. We connect business with technology to improve business performance. We have extensive experience throughout Australia and abroad, providing business analysis as a service across the ASX 200, corporate, government and not-for-profit sectors.
Along with our consultancy services, BAPL also offers education services and a BA Centre of Excellence to our clients and our people. Our mantra is “delivery success” and our unique business model, and industry leading IP, enables us to do just that, which is to deliver successful outcomes consistently.

We require full time Business Analysis Consultants.

OUR VALUES
- Product and service value – we provide valuable products and services that meet agreed expectations and uplift client business analysis capability.
- Outcome-focused delivery – refining work practices to deliver outcomes efficiently, creating reusable assets for the Practice to leverage.
- Professionalism, practice & partnership – enriching our practice with a team of professionals who value and promote our cultural foundations of service excellence, professional development, family, fun, partnership, knowledge sharing, thought leadership, accountability, and resilience.
- Collaboration based on mutual respect – collaborating with customers and the Practice to achieve better outcomes, underpinned by mutual respect for the feelings, dignity, rights, and personal views of all. Retaining talented people through supportive, fair and respectful treatment, competitive remuneration, development opportunities and recognition.
- Community – Investing in the business analysis community, including our Practice, our customers and through our affiliations with peak industry associations, advocating for criticality of exceptional business analysis in improving business performance.

WHAT WE OFFER THE RIGHT CANDIDATE
- Opportunity to work at Australia's leading business analysis specialist practice.
- Exciting assignments across a wide range of industries and sectors, supporting Australia’s most innovative organisations to deliver high-profile projects.
- Contribute to the success of our customers by helping them become more successful with their software initiatives, products, and services.
- Develop deep knowledge of different domains applying BAPL IP.
- A supportive culture to help you become a leading business analysis specialist.
- Strong focus on career and professional/personal development including career planning, fortnightly development sessions, knowledge sharing sessions, training in the BABOK V3, access to a mentor, yearly in-house development days, and access to both the BAPL and IIBA development centres.
- Access to a network of highly skilled BA colleagues and management support at any time.
- Support in your business analysis certification.
- Engage in business analysis thought leadership through a variety of channels aimed at helping you build a strong personal brand including IP development, knowledge sharing, and driving the business analysis industry forward.
- Contribute to our positive culture with your diversity of experience, capabilities, and unique value.
- Career pathways into leadership positions as the organisation grows.

WHAT YOU NEED
- Essential Competencies, Skills, and Experience
- Minimum 1-2 years' experience delivering Business Analysis services.
- Experience delivering in Agile/traditional methodologies.
- Excellent stakeholder engagement and management skills across all capability levels.
- Experience facilitating workshops with a range of stakeholders.
- Experience in requirements elicitation, definition, traceability, and management across different delivery methodologies.
- Strong communication skills - both verbally and in written form - at all levels within an organisation (business and technical).
- Experience in business process analysis, process improvement and process modelling.
- Experience delivering BA services via web collaboration tools.

NOTE: All successful applicants will be subject to a Criminal History Check, in alignment with our customers' requirements.
If you meet all the essential criteria, please submit your CV via this Ad, citing all relevant experience in support of the criteria outlined above.

Salary offered is $75k to $85k

Job Description
We are looking for a seasoned and highly capable Senior Cyber Security Analyst to join our team. In this key role, you will be responsible for protecting the organisation’s systems, networks, and data against evolving cyber threats. Your deep knowledge of cyber security frameworks, risk management, incident response, and operational security will be essential in maintaining our security posture and meeting regulatory requirements. This is a great opportunity to take the lead on critical cyber security initiatives while guiding and mentoring junior team members.
Responsibilities:
Lead the development and implementation of comprehensive cyber security strategies and initiatives
Conduct regular security risk assessments, identify vulnerabilities, and recommend appropriate controls and countermeasures
Monitor and analyse security events, alerts, and logs to detect and respond to potential threats and breaches
Lead incident response efforts, including investigation, containment, eradication, and recovery, ensuring timely and effective resolution
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design and implement secure infrastructure, systems, and applications
Conduct security assessments and penetration testing to identify and address vulnerabilities
Provide guidance and support in the development and implementation of security policies, standards, and procedures
Stay up to date with the latest cyber security threats, trends, and technologies, and recommend proactive measures to enhance our security posture
Mentor and provide guidance to junior members of the cyber security team, promoting professional growth and development
Ensure compliance with relevant industry regulations and frameworks (e.g., ISO 27001, NIST, GDPR)
Requirements:
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
Must have at least 2 years of proven work experience as a Cyber Security Analyst, with a focus on security operations, incident response, and risk assessment
In-depth knowledge of cyber security principles, frameworks, and best practices
Experience with security monitoring tools, SIEM solutions, and threat intelligence platforms
Familiarity with penetration testing methodologies, vulnerability assessment tools, and secure coding practices
Strong understanding of network security, firewall configuration, intrusion detection systems, and endpoint protection
Proficiency in scripting languages (e.g., Python, PowerShell) for automation and security tool integration
Familiarity with cloud security principles and technologies (e.g., AWS, Azure)
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to analyse complex security issues and recommend effective solutions
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to convey complex security concepts to technical and non-technical stakeholders
Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CEH, or GIAC certifications are highly desirable
Proven leadership skills, with the ability to lead and mentor junior team members
Permanent Residents (PR) and Australian Citizens are eligible to apply
Job Type: Full-time
Salary: $70,000 to $120,000 per year + super

Role Purpose

The ICT Business Development Manager will identify, develop and manage commercial opportunities for ICT and digital business solutions. The role is responsible for understanding client technology requirements, promoting ICT services, preparing solution proposals, managing client relationships, and coordinating with internal and external stakeholders to support successful delivery of digital and technology-enabled business solutions.

Key Roles and Responsibilities

Identify and develop new business opportunities for ICT, digital transformation, software, web, automation, IT support and business process technology services.
Research target markets, industry trends, competitor activity and client requirements to support ICT business growth strategies.
Engage with prospective and existing clients to understand ICT needs, operational challenges and opportunities for technology-enabled improvement.
Prepare ICT solution proposals, presentations, business cases, quotes and service scope documents in consultation with technical and management teams.
Promote the organisation's ICT and digital services to clients, partners and stakeholders through professional consultation and relationship management.
Manage the business development pipeline, including lead generation, qualification, follow-up, negotiation support and conversion reporting.
Coordinate with technical teams, consultants, vendors and service partners to ensure proposed ICT solutions are commercially viable and deliverable.
Support contract discussions, client onboarding, implementation planning and post-sale client relationship management for ICT service engagements.
Maintain CRM records, sales forecasts, client communication records and management reports relating to ICT business development activities.
Develop strategic partnerships and referral channels for ICT services, digital solutions, remote staffing, outsourcing and business process support.
Monitor project and client feedback to identify service improvements, renewal opportunities and additional ICT solution requirements.
Ensure business development activities comply with company policies, ethical standards and applicable employment, privacy and commercial obligations.
Required Experience

Minimum five (5) years of professional experience in business development, sales, client relationship management, management consulting, project coordination or a closely related commercial role.
At least two (2) years of the total experience must be closely related to ICT business development, ICT sales, digital solutions, technology services, software/web solutions, IT outsourcing, business process technology or digital transformation services.
Demonstrated experience identifying client ICT needs, preparing commercial proposals and supporting the sale or delivery of ICT/digital services.
Experience working with technical teams, vendors, consultants or project delivery teams to translate client requirements into practical ICT service solutions.
Experience using CRM systems, market research, sales reporting, stakeholder management and business communication tools.
Required Qualifications and Skills

Bachelor degree or higher in Business, Management, Marketing, Information Technology, Digital Business, Project Management or a closely related field. An MBA or postgraduate business qualification is highly regarded.
Strong understanding of ICT services, digital transformation, technology-enabled business solutions and commercial proposal development.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare professional proposals, reports and client presentations.
Strong analytical, negotiation, stakeholder engagement and relationship management skills.
Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities and coordinate with internal and external teams in a professional environment.
Selection Criteria

Proven ability to generate and manage ICT-related business development opportunities.
Strong commercial understanding of client needs, solution scoping and ICT service delivery requirements.
Ability to build long-term client relationships and communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Demonstrated capacity to prepare high-quality proposals, reports and business cases for ICT/digital services.
Ability to contribute to business growth, market expansion and service improvement strategies.
Employment Conditions

This is a full-time position based in Canberra, ACT. Primary location: Canberra, ACT. The employee may be required to work from other Australian locations if required by the employer due to business or project needs. The employee will work 38 hours per week, Monday to Friday. Remuneration is AUD 150,000 gross per annum plus superannuation, subject to final employment agreement. The role is intended to support ongoing ICT business development and digital solutions growth for the business.

For the candidate
Full Time Contract
Hybrid location - Sydney
This is a permanent role so please only apply if you have full working rights in Australia.
No recruitment agencies please

MedicalJobsAustralia.com     Data Business Analyst

Shape the future of data-driven healthcare at Epworth

At Epworth, Every Patient Matters. We are looking for a highly capable Data Business Analyst to join our team and play a key role in advancing our journey towards becoming a truly data-driven organisation. Working closely with business leaders, technical teams and reporting analysts, you'll transform business challenges into practical data solutions that improve decision-making and deliver meaningful organisational outcomes.

The Opportunity

Reporting to the Director, Data and Decision Support, you will partner with stakeholders across the business to understand priorities, define requirements and design data solutions that support strategic objectives. You'll work at the intersection of business, technology and analytics, helping turn complex data into actionable insights that drive performance across Epworth

This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced Data Business Analyst who enjoys stakeholder engagement, solution design and project delivery in a collaborative healthcare environment.

You will:

Partner with stakeholders to identify opportunities, define business problems and gather requirements

Translate business needs into clear user stories, process maps, business rules and technical documentation

Work closely with Reporting Analysts and Data Governance teams to develop meaningful reporting, KPIs and dashboards

Support solution design, business case development and data-led decision making

Contribute to project delivery across Agile and Waterfall environments

Facilitate testing, user acceptance activities and stakeholder engagement

Deliver training, documentation and support to improve data literacy across the organisation

Position Description Inherent Requirement

About You

You will be a highly capable and motivated professional with strong interpersonal, organisational and stakeholder management skills, supported by excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities. Self-motivated and adaptable, you will thrive in fast-paced environments, demonstrate sound judgement and integrity, communicate effectively with diverse stakeholders, and be committed to continuous improvement, quality outcomes and exceptional customer service.

To be successful, you will have:

Tertiary qualifications in Business, Data, Information Systems or a related discipline

Business Analysis qualifications or equivalent experience

3+ years experience in Business Analyst roles, with strong background in healthcare

Strong requirements gathering, process mapping and stakeholder engagement skills

Experience exploring and validating data using SSMS, BigQuery or similar cloud data platforms

Knowledge of healthcare operations, performance drivers and reporting environments

Experience working within Agile and project delivery frameworks

Excellent communication skills with the ability to engage technical and non-technical audiences

Experience with dashboard and reporting development will be highly regarded

Why Join Us?

You'll be part of a collaborative and forward-thinking team that values innovation, continuous improvement, and meaningful impact. If you're passionate about using data to drive better decisions and outcomes in healthcare, we'd love to hear from you.

At Epworth, it's a community

It's the sense of belonging and being part of an organisation and a team that works to make sure that every patient matters. In addition to this, you will have access to:

Salary package up to $15,900 pre-tax annually, leading to greater take home pay

The largest educational scholarship program of its kind in Australia

Ability to purchase up to four additional weeks of leave

Reduced cost of health services for you and your family at Epworth

Relocation assistance is available for approved candidates

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds. This includes First Nations peoples, people with disability, mature-age and young job seekers, members of the LGBTIQA+ community, and individuals from all cultural backgrounds. We are committed to providing an equitable, inclusive, and barrier-free recruitment experience for everyone.

If you need support during the application process or would like to discuss reasonable adjustments, we encourage you to let us know what you need to participate fully and confidently. We understand that sharing your needs can feel daunting, so please know that any information you provide will be treated with the utmost confidentiality and respect.

Apply now

As part of the application process, please also respond to the following selection criteria questions in your cover letter:

Key Selection Criteria Questions

What experience do you have working with healthcare data, hospital operations or healthcare performance reporting?

This is a senior consulting role responsible for analysing business operations, identifying technology opportunities, gathering and documenting business requirements, and working closely with stakeholders and software development teams to deliver high-quality ICT solutions.  The successful candidate will play a critical role throughout the entire project lifecycle, from requirements analysis and solution design through implementation, testing, deployment and post-implementation support.   Benefits   What We Offer    Competitive remuneration package.   Long-term career opportunities with an established Australian ICT company.   Exposure to enterprise-level digital transformation projects.   Professional development and ongoing technical training.   Collaborative and supportive working environment.   Opportunity to work with clients across multiple industries.   International project exposure where required.     Task & responsibilities   Key Responsibilities   You will be responsible for:   Leading workshops with business stakeholders to gather, analyse and document business requirements.   Analysing existing business processes, workflows and enterprise systems to identify improvement opportunities.   Preparing Business Requirement Documents (BRDs), Functional Specification Documents (FSDs), user stories, process maps and workflow documentation.   Performing gap analysis between business requirements and existing system capabilities, recommending practical ICT solutions.   Working closely with software architects, developers, testers and project managers to ensure business requirements are accurately translated into technical solutions.   Preparing process models, workflow diagrams, data flow diagrams and business rules using appropriate modelling tools.   Managing requirements traceability and assessing the impact of change requests throughout project delivery.   Supporting Agile, Scrum and Waterfall software development methodologies.   Coordinating System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), defect management and solution validation.   Supporting enterprise software implementation, systems integration and digital transformation projects.   Facilitating communication between business users and technical teams throughout the SDLC.   Producing user documentation, training materials and conducting client training sessions.   Monitoring project progress, identifying project risks and assisting project managers in delivering successful outcomes.   Providing ongoing post-implementation business analysis and continuous improvement recommendations.   Supporting the company's Australian and international project teams when required.     Qualification & experience   Qualifications   Applicants should possess:   A relevant ICT qualification such as an Advanced Diploma, Diploma, Bachelor's degree or higher in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems or a related discipline. Applicants with substantial industry experience in ICT Business Analysis may also be considered.  Relevant ICT industry certifications will be viewed favorably.    Skills & Experience   The successful applicant should demonstrate:   Minimum 5 years' professional experience as an ICT Business Analyst or Senior Business Analyst.   Strong experience working across the complete Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).   Extensive experience in business requirements elicitation, stakeholder management and business process analysis.   Proven experience preparing BRDs, FSDs, SRS documentation and user stories.   Experience with Agile, Scrum and Waterfall methodologies.   Experience conducting workshops, solution analysis and requirements validation.   Strong understanding of enterprise software implementation and systems integration projects.   Experience coordinating SIT, UAT and production deployment activities.    Experience in one or more of the following will be highly regarded:   Banking or financial services systems   Payment platforms   Enterprise application integration   Digital transformation initiatives   Cloud-based business systems   ERP or CRM implementation projects    About Company     Company Profile   Advance Vision Technology (AVTech) is an Australian ICT solutions provider with more than 30 years of experience delivering innovative enterprise technology solutions across Australia and Asia.
